description: Reusable confidence level definitions used by calculators, reference pages, datasets, and methodology documentation.

records.label: High Confidence
records.description: Value derived from peer-reviewed scientific literature or consensus industry standards (PHTA, ANSI, WHO).
records.applicableWhen: Strong scientific consensus. Widely adopted by industry.

records.label: Medium Confidence
records.description: Value based on widely accepted industry practice or manufacturer documentation with broad adoption.
records.applicableWhen: Industry consensus but limited peer-reviewed support, or values vary by source.

records.label: Low Confidence
records.description: Value derived from limited sources, editorial judgment, or emerging guidance not yet widely adopted.
records.applicableWhen: Sparse or conflicting sources. Editorial interpretation required.

records.label: Estimated
records.description: Value calculated or interpolated from related data. Not directly measured or specified.
records.applicableWhen: No direct measurement available. Derived from first principles or related data.

records.label: Manufacturer Specified
records.description: Value from manufacturer documentation. May vary by product. Consult your specific product label.
records.applicableWhen: Product-specific values (e.g., salt cell salt range, chlorinator dose rate).
